ideas.title: Chisel Rocks for Eggs
ideas.hook: Every boulder hides a sculpture. Chisel it into shape, and the better your statue looks, the rarer the geode egg that cracks out of its heart.
core_loop: Drag a boulder onto your workbench
Chisel along the glowing outline before the timer ends
Score the statue's accuracy
Crack the geode egg and hatch a stone pet that chisels faster
ideas.twist: Accuracy, not clicks, decides the egg tier, so a careful new player can beat a fast one.
retention: Offline polishing that adds shine while away
ideas.why_now: Paint / create × Stones / rocks / ores is the top open gap (8.19). Paint / create is up 2.23x (Paint to Get Rich 25.5K CCU, Paint a Pancake 13.6K) and Stones / rocks / ores is up 2.5x (+1 Stone Skipping 47.0K, Lift Rock For Eggs 16.3K). "___ for ___" titles lead at 3.49x.
ideas.differentiator: Rock games are about lifting or smashing; this one rewards making something with the rock.

ideas.title: Dye Eggs for Pets
ideas.hook: Paint a blank egg any way you like. The colours and patterns you use decide which pet hatches out.
core_loop: Grab a blank egg from the nest
Paint stripes, dots and colours on it
Put it in the incubator
Hatch a pet that matches your pattern and add it to the index
ideas.twist: Secret patterns (all red, perfect stripes, a smiley face) hatch hidden pets, so players trade pattern tips.
retention: Weekly paint contest voted by players
ideas.why_now: Paint / create × Eggs is the second-best open gap (7.98). Paint / create is up 2.23x (Paint a Pancake 13.6K CCU) and the Collect / index + Hatch / gacha pair holds 297.7K young CCU (Break and Steal an Egg 200.5K, Bike For Egg! 25.5K).
ideas.differentiator: Egg games hand you a random egg; here you design the egg and the art you make drives the roll.

ideas.title: Scrap Mechs for Parts
ideas.hook: A junkyard full of broken mechs. Smash them apart for parts, then bolt the parts onto your own mech in your garage.
core_loop: Pick a wrecked mech in the junkyard
Smash it until parts pop off
Carry parts back to your garage
Bolt them onto your mech to smash bigger wrecks
ideas.twist: Parts keep their rarity colour, so a mech built from all-gold parts unlocks a secret garage skin.
retention: Offline scrap pile at your garage
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig × Robots / mechs is an open gap (6.14). Break / mine / dig is the fastest mechanic at 2.84x (Break and Steal an Egg 200.5K CCU, Smash the City 13.6K) and Robots / mechs is up 1.57x (WRONG WAY! 12.8K). Hub + zones maps are rising at 1.99x.
ideas.differentiator: Robot games let you pilot a mech; here you earn it bolt by bolt from what you break.

ideas.title: Crack Coffins for Pets
ideas.hook: A spooky graveyard full of coffins. Crack them open to free zombie pets who follow you and dig faster.
core_loop: Walk up to a coffin
Smash the lid with your shovel
Catch the zombie pet before it shuffles off
Equip pets to crack sturdier coffins in deeper crypts
ideas.twist: Each night the graveyard fills with new coffins, and the last coffin of the night always holds a boss zombie.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig × Zombies is an open gap (5.48). Break / mine / dig leads mechanics at 2.84x (Break and Steal an Egg 200.5K CCU, My Anime Mine 11.4K) and Collect / index is up 1.66x (Lift Rock For Eggs 16.3K). Zombie themes already pull young players (Build and Kill Zombies 13.8K).
ideas.differentiator: Zombie games are about fighting them off; here you dig them up and collect them.

ideas.title: Restore Dinos for Cash
ideas.hook: Dig up fossils, paint them back to life, and show them off in your own dino museum that earns cash from visitors.
core_loop: Dig fossil bones in the quarry
Assemble the skeleton on your stand
Paint skin colours onto it
Open the exhibit and earn ticket cash
ideas.twist: The colours you pick matter: visitors pay more for the dino that matches today's trending colour.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create × Dinosaurs is an open gap (5.18). Paint / create is up 2.23x (Paint to Get Rich 25.5K CCU), Dinosaurs is up 1.66x (Ride a Dino 17.0K, Prehistoric Farm 9.2K) and Sell / run a shop is up 1.84x (Sell Fries! 97.9K).
ideas.differentiator: Dino games let you ride or farm dinos; this one makes you the artist who brings them back.

ideas.title: Bat Meteors for Dinos
ideas.hook: Meteors are falling on the dino nest. Swing your bat to knock them away, and every hit makes you +1 stronger.
core_loop: Stand on the nest platform
Time your swing as meteors fall
Gain +1 power for each hit
Save eggs to hatch dinos that boost your swing
ideas.twist: Bigger meteors fly further when hit; knock one into the volcano for a jackpot egg.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch × Dinosaurs is an open gap (4.63). Hit / swing / launch is up 1.99x (+1 Stone Skipping 47.0K CCU, Cat Battles 21.6K), "+1 ___" titles are up 1.85x and the Hit + +1 stat pair holds 57.7K young CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Hit games launch things for distance; this one turns every swing into a save with a reason to aim.

ideas.title: +1 Drum Smash
ideas.hook: Every drum hit gives +1 power. Hit hard enough and the sound wave launches everything around you.
core_loop: Bang the drum to the beat
Gain +1 power per on-beat hit
Release a shockwave that launches crates
Collect loot and buy bigger drums
ideas.twist: Hitting exactly on the beat doubles the gain, so rhythm skill beats spam clicking.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat × Music / dance is an open gap (3.64) and Hit × Music another (4.21). "+1 ___" titles are up 1.85x (+1 Stone Skipping 47.0K CCU, +1 Karate Evolution 14.0K) and Music / dance is up 1.43x (Piano Rhythm Tiles 8.2K, Aura Dance Battles 5.7K).
ideas.differentiator: Music games are about playing songs; this one turns rhythm into raw power.

ideas.title: Stylists vs Critics
ideas.hook: Grumpy critics are marching down your runway. Place stylists along the path to give each critic a makeover before they reach the judges.
core_loop: Place stylist towers along the runway
Each stylist adds hair, makeup or outfit
Fully styled critics turn into fans and pay out
Unlock new stylists for tougher waves
ideas.twist: Critics have style tags; matching stylists to tags turns them into fans faster.
ideas.why_now: Tower defense × Fashion / beauty is an open gap (4.5). Fashion / beauty is up 1.83x (Facecard: Makeup Showdown 34.2K CCU, Makeup Star 5.5K), Tower defense is up 1.52x (Cameraman Tower Defense 20.1K) and "___ vs ___" titles are up 1.38x (Bunker vs Verity 42.5K).
ideas.differentiator: Fashion games are about dressing yourself; here you style an army of strangers under pressure.

ideas.title: Sell Capes to Heroes
ideas.hook: Run the shop superheroes visit between fights. Stitch capes, masks and gadgets and sell them at the counter.
core_loop: Take a hero's order at the counter
Craft the cape or gadget at your bench
Hand it over and get paid
Expand the shop for bigger heroes
ideas.twist: Heroes return from fights with damaged gear; repair jobs pay double but need fast work.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop × Superheroes / powers is an open gap (3.78). Sell / run a shop is up 1.84x (Sell Fries! 97.9K CCU), Superheroes is up 1.32x (Superhero Arena 14.1K) and interior maps are rising 1.75x.
ideas.differentiator: Superhero games make you the hero; this one makes you the shopkeeper who keeps them flying.

ideas.title: Paint Tombs for Gold
ideas.hook: Build your tomb and paint its walls with murals. Every mural earns gold, but other players can sneak in to steal the treasure.
core_loop: Build tomb rooms on your plot
Paint murals that earn gold per second
Set traps to guard the treasure
Raid other tombs for rare relics
ideas.twist: Better murals earn more but also attract more raiders, so painters must build traps too.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create × Ancient / pyramids is an open gap (4.08). Paint / create is up 2.23x (Paint to Get Rich 25.5K CCU), Tycoon / base building is up 1.92x (Climb For Animals Eggs 62.0K) and the Steal + Tycoon pair holds 16 young games with 55.0K CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Pyramid tycoons stack blocks; here what you paint is what you earn and what others try to steal.
